name: Hisaizu Rin
source:
[i]"We want to reclaim both fire and the night—for they once belonged to us."[/i]

Someone who's accompanying you during your stay in the village. He is a well-informed, playful gentleman who runs a funeral home in the village. Behind his smile lies a strong sense of personal conviction and a subtle tendency to avoid contact with another's hand.

[Translated from [url=https://hyakunie.com/character/rin-hisaizu/]official website[/url]]
